purpose: The host overlay menu on the left edge: Profile, Search, Home, Movies, Series, then Games and Live TV only when installed, then Settings. It slides over the page and returns focus to the tile it was opened from.

anatomy.note: Opaque pack surface, 18dp elevation, slid in from the left; the page dims behind it.
SCENIX lettering at the top, never a duplicate Home stop.
Click/Back closes; the scrim never takes focus.

rules: Opening the rail focuses the row for the section the viewer is standing in.
UP/DOWN stop at the first and last row; LEFT/RIGHT never leave the panel.
Back closes the rail and returns focus to the exact tile that opened it.
Choosing a destination closes the rail before the page changes.

behaviour: The white focus pill is host-owned; a pack brand fill disappears on Kids and Glass.
Games and Live TV rows are omitted when the add-ons are absent.
The rail is an overlay: it never reflows the shelves.

platformDeltas.ios: A sheet or drawer rather than a TV overlay; same row order, safe-area inset, swipe-back.
platformDeltas.windows: Left rail can be persistent at >=1440px; keyboard focus order identical.
platformDeltas.apple-tv: Same overlay; focus lift on the row, same scrim.
